host_boundary: Original complete linewidth methods and _scale_dashes under explicit initial width=2 and clean-stale setup; original Line data/unit host records no data cache/request mutation. Actual GC methods and original complete SVG _get_style_dict/_get_style with fixed valid black RGBA tuple, solid no-hatch/no-face, real complete numeric to_hex/to_rgba helpers and empty named-color cache. No full draw/renderer/GUI/color-validator parity claim.

typed_boundary.setters: All 28 setter records project width, stale, invalid flags, retained cache, dataLim and requests onto two typed solid-Line sequences. Native scale_dashes/dash state remains source evidence; the typed slice has no dash state or new rc API.
typed_boundary.svg_primitives: All 11 native style dictionaries/CSS strings are source-only. Native stroke omission/default-width and six-decimal fixed formatting differ from the existing typed serializer convenience profile.
typed_boundary.float: Finite numbers including signed zero and infinities are asserted by bits; NaN is asserted by classification, without a payload contract.
typed_boundary.initialization: Initial width 2 is the existing typed plot convenience setup, not the native Line2D rc default. Private mark_drawn supplies the controlled stale=False input before each setter without invoking a draw or visibility branch.
